description: This file defines the 'RequestResponseResult' class, a generic container for holding API response data such as status code, payload, cache directives, and application properties, particularly in the context of a request-response pattern within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: RequestResponseResult
classes.description: A generic class encapsulating the response result of a Hono API request, including status, payload, cache directives, and application properties.

methods.name: RequestResponseResult
methods.description: Constructor initializing the result with status, payload, cache directive, and application properties.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status code indicating the result of the request.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload contained in the result.

methods.name: getCacheDirective
methods.description: Returns the cache directive associated with the response, if any.

methods.name: getApplicationProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific application property by key, cast to the expected type.

methods.name: getApplicationProperties
methods.description: Returns all application properties as an unmodifiable map.

methods.name: isOk
methods.description: Checks if the response status is HTTP 200 OK.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the status code indicates an error (HTTP 4xx or 5xx).
